mapper.insert: INSERT INTO child_spending_reports (child_id, report_type_id, report_year, report_month, total_spent, transaction_count, top_spots, total_saved, allowance_received, saving_rate, advice) VALUES (#{childId}, #{reportTypeId}, #{reportYear}, #{reportMonth}, #{totalSpent}, #{transactionCount}, #{topSpots}, #{totalSaved}, #{allowanceReceived}, #{savingRate}, #{advice}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_type_id = VALUES(report_type_id), total_spent = VALUES(total_spent), transaction_count = VALUES(transaction_count), top_spots = VALUES(top_spots), total_saved = VALUES(total_saved), allowance_received = VALUES(allowance_received), saving_rate = VALUES(saving_rate), advice = VALUES(advice)
